cardOverview.overviewText: A First Wow card delivering simple rewards, milestone perks, and affordability, crafted for entry-level users.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.offer: 50% discount of upto ₹300 on movie ticket bookings made through BookMyShow. Additionally, moviegoers can receive discounts on food and beverages (Upto ₹200) when using this card. Furthermore, non-movie ticket bookings are eligible for a 50% discount of upto ₹500.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: EazyDiner
benefitRows.offer: Flat Rs. 400 Instant Discount Min. bill of ₹4000.|Valid once per card per month
